patterns.note: Asymmetrical hero section with a large visual element on one side and dominant, oversized typography on the other, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
Primary headings are exceptionally large, bold, sans-serif, and often underlined, serving as key visual anchors and conveying an editorial aesthetic.
A high-contrast black and white color scheme dominates the entire site, with minimal use of other colors, emphasizing clarity and sophistication.
The main navigation bar transforms from transparent over the hero to an opaque, slightly shrunken, sticky header with a white background upon scroll.
Content sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic reading experience.
Course lessons are presented in a responsive grid layout, each card featuring a small, stylized thumbnail and concise text description.

technique_notes: The hero section utilizes a full-bleed video (or large image) as a background element, with text overlaid directly for impact. A subtle parallax effect is applied to the background image as the user scrolls.

Scroll-triggered animations are used to reveal new content sections. As elements enter the viewport, they transition from a slightly offset and transparent state to their final position and full opacity, creating a staggered fade-up effect.

The global navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance based on scroll position. Initially transparent, it detects when the user scrolls past the hero section, then shrinks in height, gains a solid white background, and becomes sticky to the top of the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~6x body) with a clear hierarchy down to legible, standard-sized body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with almost no visible corner rounding on any elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and a balanced density within content grids.

standout: This site's design is distinctive for its bold, editorial use of typography, where oversized, high-contrast sans-serif headings are the primary visual elements. This, combined with a minimalist black-and-white palette and asymmetrical layouts, creates a sophisticated, magazine-like aesthetic that feels more like a curated publication than a typical marketing site.
